notes: Ship rows now say 1MC where they used to say TX ALL — same control, the fleet's own name for it: transmit to every net aboard, no tuning needed. The 1MC clip library is now fleet property instead of files on one machine: COMMAND manages it under SYS → 1MC SOUND LIBRARY, every clip added there is shared with every COMMAND account and appears on the 1MC of every ship net, and removing a clip removes it fleet-wide. Clips are capped at 4MB each. And chat has come to the COMMS board: a NET TEXT panel for the selected net now sits above the COMM LOG with its own send box, and the divider between them drags — give the space to chat or to the log, your choice, remembered. The full CHAT page with its per-net tabs is unchanged.
